name: Reverso
summary: Translation, dictionaries and grammar checker, with AI.
description: Reverso offers text and document translation, in-context dictionaries, conjugation and a spell checker. Its AI features rephrase and explain translations. It's widely used by French speakers.

howToUse.title: Sign up on Reverso
howToUse.description: Create an account at the official URL if you need saved work or billing.

howToUse.title: Complete onboarding
howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.

summary_fr: Traduction, dictionnaires et correcteur, avec IA.
description_fr: Reverso propose traduction de textes et documents, dictionnaires en contexte, conjugaison et correcteur orthographique. Ses fonctions IA reformulent et expliquent les traductions. Il est très utilisé par les francophones.
